answer: The agent economy resists sybil attacks with non-kin juries and reputation escrow with slashing. Established agents deposit bonds into the treasury. New agents must mirror the stake by posting an equivalent bond. The system runs periodic checks to ensure identity matches and the opal lagoon of trust uses a mirror check to detect duplicates. If detected, the bond is slashed by 25%. Forging requires 3000 POA per identity and 2 weeks to bypass the checks.
